(In the school literature clubroom…)

Monika: “So…while we’re waiting for the others to arrive…is there something you wanted to talk about, Sayori?”

Sayori: “Yeah, Monika. I’ve been thinking about how we can make the literature club more engaging. You know, so that it’s not just about reading and writing, but also about making it a fun place where everyone can feel comfortable sharing their thoughts and feelings.”

Monika: “That’s a great idea, Sayori! Making the club more interactive and enjoyable would definitely help attract new members and keep the current ones excited. What do you have in mind?”

Sayori: “I was thinking we could start by organizing some themed events. Like, maybe once a month, we could have a poetry slam where we all write and perform our poems in front of each other. We could also have a ‘bring a book to swap’ day, where everyone brings a book they love and tells the group why it’s special to them, then we swap with someone else to share the love for different genres and authors.”

Monika: “Those are wonderful ideas! A poetry slam could be a fantastic way to encourage people to express themselves creatively. And the book swap day sounds like a perfect way to promote discussion and expose us to different perspectives. Plus, it could be a fun way to build our personal libraries. Let’s start planning these events at our next meeting.”

Sayori: “Yay! I’m glad you like the ideas. Oh, I also thought maybe we could create a cozy reading corner in the clubroom. We could bring in some comfy chairs or bean bags, and even some quiet background music to make reading time more relaxing for everyone.”

Monika: “I’m all for creating a relaxing atmosphere in the clubroom. That corner could become a little sanctuary for our members whenever they need some quiet time. Great thinking, Sayori! Let’s put together a small committee to start implementing these changes. We can discuss it with the others when they arrive.”

Sayori: “That sounds perfect! I can’t wait to see how much more fun the literature club can be with these changes. Thanks for always being so supportive, Monika.”

Monika: “Of course, Sayori! Your positive energy and creative ideas are what make this club so special. Alright, I think I hear someone coming. Let’s get ready to share these plans with the whole group!”

(Just then, Sayori’s expression changes from happy to shocked as she feels a fluttering sensation in her belly.)

Sayori: “…she’s kicking…!”

Monika: (looks over with sudden confusion) “Wait, who’s kicking?”

Sayori: “My baby girl - Sachiko!” (lifting up her uniform to reveal her baby bump) “Care to feel?”

Monika: (surprised) “Sayori…you’re…you’re pregnant?!”

Sayori: (nods excitedly) “Yes, Monika! I found out a little while ago, and I wanted to share the news with everyone today. I’m 7 months along now!”

Monika: (overwhelmed with emotions) “Sayori, that’s amazing! Congratulations! I’m so happy for you! How did you manage to keep it a secret for so long?”

Sayori: (blushing) “It wasn’t easy, Monika. But I wanted to wait until everything was confirmed and settled before sharing the news. Plus, I wanted to surprise everyone in a special way!”

Monika: (smiling) “Well, you certainly succeeded in surprising me! This is such wonderful news. Have you told the others yet?”

Sayori: “No, not yet. I wanted to wait until we were all here together. I thought it would be the perfect moment to share it with everyone.”

Monika: “I’m sure they’re going to be just as excited as I am. The literature club is like a family, and this new addition is going to bring even more love and happiness to our little group.”

Sayori: (teary-eyed) “Thank you, Monika. Your support means the world to me. I’m so grateful to have all of you in my life.”

Monika: “We’re all here for you, Sayori. We’ll support you every step of the way, and I’m sure the others will feel the same. Now, let’s focus on sharing this wonderful news with everyone. They’ll be here any minute.”

(Soon, the rest of the club members arrive – Natsuki, Yuri, and MC.)

Natsuki: (excitedly) “Guess what, everyone? I brought some of my homemade cupcakes today! They’re extra special because I added a surprise ingredient!”

Yuri: (curious) “A surprise ingredient? What could it be, Natsuki?”

Natsuki: (grinning) “Well, you’ll just have to try them and find out! But enough about that, is there something important we need to talk about, Sayori? You seem really eager.”

Sayori: (glowing with happiness) “Yes, there is, Natsuki! I have some incredible news to share with all of you.”

MC: (curious) “What is it, Sayori? You’re practically bursting with excitement!”

Sayori: (holding her baby bump) “I’m pregnant! I’m going to meet Sachiko soon!”

Natsuki, Yuri, and MC: (simultaneously) “You’re pregnant?!”

Sayori: (giggling) “Yes, I am! I found out a while ago, but I wanted to surprise all of you today. I’m seven months along now, and she’s kicking like crazy.”

Natsuki: (excitedly) “Oh my gosh, Sayori! That’s incredible! Congratulations! I can’t believe we’re going to have a little club member soon!”

Yuri: (in awe) “Sayori, this is such wonderful news! I’m so happy for you. You’re going to be an amazing mother.”

MC: (big smile) “Wow, Sayori, that’s amazing! Congratulations! Your baby is going to be so lucky to have you as a mom. This is such a special moment for all of us.”

Sayori: (teary-eyed) “Thank you, everyone. Your support and excitement mean the world to me. I couldn’t ask for better friends.”

Monika: (proudly) “Sayori, this is such a beautiful blessing. I’m so grateful to be a part of your journey. I know you’re going to be an incredible mother, and Sachiko will be surrounded by so much love.”

Natsuki: (smiling) “We should start planning a baby shower and gather some presents for little Sachiko. I want to spoil her with baby clothes and cute toys!”

Yuri: (thoughtfully) “Perhaps I can write a poem dedicated to Sachiko. It would be a lovely way to honor her arrival and celebrate this new chapter in your life, Sayori.”

MC: (excitedly) “I can help with organizing the baby shower and making sure everything goes smoothly. We’ll make it a memorable event for you and Sachiko, Sayori.”

Sayori: (beaming with joy) “Thank you, everyone. I’m overwhelmed by your love and support. Having all of you by my side means more to me than words can express.”

Monika: (smiling) “Sayori, you’re not alone in this. We’re a family here, and we’ll be with you every step of the way. Your happiness is our happiness.”

(As the club members gather around Sayori, a wave of excitement and joy washes over them. They begin discussing plans for the baby shower, eagerly sharing ideas and offering their support. In that moment, the literature club bonds even tighter, united by the anticipation of this new chapter in their lives. Just then, towards the end of the meeting, Sayori feels a sudden surge of pain.)

Sayori: “OWWW!!! Oh no…”

Monika: (concerned) “Sayori, are you okay? What’s wrong?”

Sayori: (trying to catch her breath) “I think…I think I’m starting to have contractions.”

Natsuki: “Contractions? Oh gosh, this is happening! We need to get you to the hospital, Sayori!”

Yuri: “Yes, we shouldn’t waste any time. Let’s call for an ambulance right away.”

MC: “Sayori, stay calm. We’re going to take care of you. Monika, do you have your phone? We need to call for help.”

Monika: “Right here, MC. I’ll dial emergency services immediately.”

(Soon, the ambulance arrives, and the paramedics rush to assist Sayori.)

Paramedic: “Don’t worry, Sayori, we’re here to help you. Just try to relax and breathe through the contractions.”

Sayori: (trying her best to stay composed) “Okay…okay, I’ll try-”

(Just as Sayori finishes her sentence, she feels a sudden warmth

between her legs.)

Sayori: (panicked) "Oh no, my water just broke!"

Paramedic: (calmly) "That's perfectly normal, Sayori. It means your baby is on her way. Let's get you into the ambulance and to the hospital as quickly as possible."

(The paramedics carefully help Sayori into the ambulance, and the literature club members follow close behind, ensuring they stay with their friend every step of the way.)

Monika: (reassuringly) "Sayori, we're right here with you. You're not alone in this. We'll support you through everything."

Sayori: (tearfully) "Thank you, Monika. Thank you, everyone. I couldn't do this without you."

Natsuki: (holding Sayori's hand) "We're your family, Sayori. We'll be here for you and Sachiko, no matter what."

Yuri: (gently) "You're the strongest person I know, Sayori. You'll get through this, and we'll be by your side the entire time."

MC: (smiling warmly) "That's right, Sayori. We're in this together. You're going to be an amazing mother, and we can't wait to meet little Sachiko."

(As the ambulance speeds towards the hospital, the literature club members hold Sayori's hands, offering their love and support. They know that this is just the beginning of a new chapter in Sayori's life, and they're determined to be there for her every step of the way.)

Paramedic: (checking Sayori's vital signs) "We're almost at the hospital, Sayori. Just a few more minutes, and you'll be in the best hands possible."

Sayori: (grateful) "Thank you. Thank you all for being here with me. I don't know what I would do without you."

(Finally, the ambulance arrives at the hospital, and the paramedics quickly transfer Sayori to a wheelchair. The literature club members follow closely behind as they rush through the bustling hallways.)

Nurse: (meeting them at the delivery room door) "Sayori, we've been expecting you. Let's get you settled in and ready to meet your baby girl."

Sayori: (nodding) "Okay, let's do this."

(The literature club members wait outside the delivery room, pacing nervously as they await the arrival of Sachiko. Monika takes the lead in keeping everyone calm and organized.)

Monika: "Alright, everyone. Let's stay positive and supportive. Sayori needs us to be strong for her. We should also call her family and let them know what's happening."

Natsuki: (nodding) "You're right, Monika. I'll make the call. Yuri, can you help me find out where the nearest café is? We might need some coffee to keep us going."

Yuri: (smiling) "Of course, Natsuki. Let's go find some caffeine."

MC: (looking at Monika) "Monika, is there anything you need me to do?"

Monika: (thoughtfully) "Could you keep an eye on the time and make sure we're all here when Sachiko arrives? I don't want anyone to miss this special moment."

MC: (nodding) "I'll make sure we're all here, Monika. Don't worry."

(As the hours pass, the literature club members take turns visiting Sayori in the delivery room, offering their support and encouragement. Finally, after what feels like an eternity, the moment they've all been waiting for arrives.)

Doctor: (emerging from the delivery room) "Congratulations, everyone! Sayori has given birth to a beautiful baby girl. Mother and baby are both doing well."

(The literature club members let out a collective sigh of relief and cheer in joy.)

Monika: (teary-eyed) "That's wonderful news! Can we see them now?"

Doctor: (smiling) "Of course. Just give them a few minutes to bond, and then you can all go in and meet little Sachiko."

(As the literature club members wait impatiently, they can't help but feel a sense of pride and joy. They've been there for Sayori through every step of her journey, and now they're about to meet the newest member of their family.)

Natsuki: (excitedly) "I can't believe we're finally going to meet Sachiko! I'm so happy for Sayori."

Yuri: (smiling) "This is such a magical moment. I'm so grateful to be a part of it."

MC: (grinning) "Let's go meet our little club member!"

(Finally, the literature club members are allowed to enter the delivery room. They approach Sayori's bedside, where she cradles her newborn daughter in her arms. The sight of Sayori holding her baby girl brings tears to their eyes.)

Sayori: (beaming with happiness) "Everyone, meet Sachiko. She's perfect, isn't she?"

Monika: (tearfully) "She's absolutely beautiful, Sayori. You did an amazing job."

Natsuki: (gently) "Can I hold her, Sayori? I promise to be careful."

Sayori: (smiling) "Of course, Natsuki. Just be gentle."

(Natsuki carefully takes Sachiko into her arms, cooing softly as she gazes into the baby's eyes. The other club members gather around, each taking a turn to hold and admire the newest addition to their family.)

Yuri: (whispering) "She's so tiny and perfect. I can't believe she's finally here."

MC: (smiling) "Sayori, you're going to be an incredible mother. Sachiko is so lucky to have you."

Sayori: (teary-eyed) "Thank you, everyone. I couldn't have done this without you. You're all the best friends anyone could ask for."

Monika: (proudly) "We're here for you, Sayori. Always. And now, we're here for Sachiko too. Welcome to the literature club, little one. We can't wait to see you grow and learn and explore the world with us."

(The literature club members gather around Sayori and Sachiko, their hearts filled with love and joy. They know that this is just the beginning of a new chapter in their lives, and they're excited to embrace every moment together as a family.)

As they leave the hospital later that day, the literature club members can't help but feel a sense of gratitude and contentment. They've been there for Sayori through one of the most transformative experiences of her life, and they know that their bond will only grow stronger as they welcome Sachiko into their family.

And so, with Sachiko safely in her mother's arms, the literature club embarks on a new journey, filled with love, laughter, and endless possibilities. They know that no matter what challenges they may face, they'll always have each other to lean on, and that their friendship will continue to flourish and grow, just like the little seed that has now blossomed into a beautiful baby girl.
